discovery.title: A NASA telescope may soon fall back to Earth
discovery.summary: NASA’s Swift space telescope is nearing an uncontrolled return to Earth after a rescue attempt failed. Its remaining debris is expected to fall into the ocean.
discovery.why_it_matters: Swift has tracked cosmic explosions for over two decades; its loss raises questions about how we protect valuable space observatories from orbital decay.
